sources.title: Turning a Non-Reasoning Model into a Reasoning Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: A simple, hands-on tutorial that takes a small base model (Qwen2.5-1.5B) and teaches it to think before it answers — the same "reasoning" behavior you see in models like o1 and DeepSeek-R1.

sources.title: Turning a Non-Reasoning Model into a Reasoning Model
sources.snippet: Base Model Qwen2.5-1.5B 1. SFT learn to think 2. GRPO practice + reward Reasoning Model thinks before answering The full pipeline: start from a plain base model, teach it the reasoning format with SFT, sharpen it with GRPO reinforcement learning, then evaluate.

sources.title: Building a Reasoning Model from Scratch: A Practical Tutorial on SFT ...
sources.snippet: Building a Reasoning Model from Scratch: A Practical Tutorial on SFT and GRPO for Qwen2.5-1.5B This article details how to transform an ordinary large language model into one with chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, including a complete three-stage training process and reproducible Colab notebooks.
